content: काष्ठम् [काश्-क्थन् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 2</ls>] .²1 A piece of wood, especially one used as fuel; <ls>Ms. 4. 49</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 4.">241</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 69</ls>. .²2 Wood or timber, a piece or log of wood in general; यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महोदधौ <ls>H. 4. 69</ls>; <ls>Ms. 4. 40</ls>. .²8 A stick; शोणितेन विना दुःखं कुर्वन् काष्ठादिभिर्नरः <ls>Y. 2. 218</ls>. .²4 An instrument for measuring length.
